sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head reddish brown except the vertex; vertex, genae and the region around the rostral hump slightly paler; antennae, coxae and femora brown; sternites, tibiae and tarsi light brown; tergites dark brown. A pair of setae on the vertex, a pair behind the frons, 1–2 on the frons; pronotal margins with very short setae; tergites with short, scattered setae; sternites with long setae. Head shaped as in the original figure; in lateral view moderately concave, the rostral hump slightly indicated; rostrum short. Antennae 14-segmented; segment 2 half the length of segment 3, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 4. Pronotum nearly twice as wide as long; anterior margin moderately convex. Measurements (10 soldiers, in mm; range / mean): head length (including rostrum) 1.62–1.82/1.76; head width 1.09–1.19/1.15; rostrum length (from the tip of the rostrum to the deepest point below its base, measured along the rostral axis) 0.50–0.58/0.55; pronotal length 0.31–0.36/0.34; pronotal width 0.63–0.67/0.64.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Close to H. rufus from the Malay Peninsula, differing in the stouter frons; the relative length of antennal segments 3 and 4 (in H. rufus segment 3 is equal in length to segment 4); and the slightly less convex anterior margin of the pronotum. H. monoceros from Ceylon is also close, but differs in body colour and in the length of the antennal segments.
